description: Returns the full vocabulary of selectable plant filter values for the current viewer locale: enum lists (flowerColor, bloomPeriod, sunlight, soil, foliageType, foliageColor, maintenanceLevel, form) and observed numeric ranges (height, spread, hardiness). Call this BEFORE search_plants so you pick only valid values; values not in this vocabulary will yield empty results from search_plants. Lazy-loaded once per session and cached.
name: get_plant_attributes
